Configuration checks

  • Evaluate the complete payload and its effect on vehicle balance.
  • Confirm the launch method, available power and recovery equipment.
  • Define data outputs and the accuracy needed from optional positioning.

COMPLETE SYSTEM

Specify more than
the vehicle.

A payload allowance is not an assurance that any sensor will integrate. Confirm the specific sensor model, interfaces and tested setup.

Confirm in the delivered scope

  • Vehicle and installed payload
  • Control station and software functions
  • Tether length, reel and power supply
  • Selected tools, sensors and deployment equipment
  • Transport cases, spares, manuals and training

Standard, optional and custom items must be listed separately in the quotation.
